releases.notes:
# Added:
- Added `disable_stargate_generation_preference`, which, when true, makes the Stargate Network not consider the generation of a Stargate when choosing a preferred Stargate

# Changes:
- Andromeda Stargate and DHD now have 42 symbols
- Andromeda Stargate now has slightly more delay between engaging a chevron and sending the travelling symbol out
- Tweaked Andromeda Stargate texture and its symbol colors
- Changed the symbol color definitions for Stargate Variants (check wiki for details about the new one)
- Slightly changed the algorithm used to generate addresses for other modded dimensions, meaning you might need to check cartouches to get their new addresses
- The `random_addresses_from_seed` config option is now false by default, meaning that addresses randomly assigned to other modded dimensions will no longer be different between seeds (Setting the config option to true will bring back the old behaviour)
- Buried Stargate (Alpha gate) and Terra Stargate (Beta gate) are now by default pre-loaded when first loading into the world

# Fixes:
- Fixed Andromeda Stargate Upgrade Crystal not being craftable (1.21.1)
- Fixed Kaliem Galaxy symbols missing some textures
- Fixed Stargate returning "Target Stargate is obstructed" error instead of "Not enough power" error when a Stargate with not enough power dialed a 7/8-chevron address to a Dimension with 2 or more Stargates, where one of them was obstructed
